SavedData and exact native entity writes are synchronously acknowledged at critical transitions, which can expose slow or failing disks as pending recovery
Unknown or unloaded canonical identities intentionally block replacement until actual loading and persistence resolve
Forge Mixin binding, mod-specific scripted attacks/teleports/multipart bodies and real crash windows require actual runtime acceptance
Mounted Start rejects the complete family before movement, while native mounted boundary/return safety remains subject to runtime acceptance
Receipt/tombstone sets intentionally persist for replay safety and are not automatically pruned
Truly asynchronous mod damage with neither native ownership nor captured synchronous provenance requires a specific audited native adapter. It is not guessed from proximity
